comment: teleport.c safe_teleds() 766-767: with no free non-trap spot, the hero lands on the first trap spot teleok(,,TRUE) accepts. A debug Priest level-teleports to the first level of Vlad's Tower, wishes for a squeaky board under her (spot A, at a dead end between two doors), fills every other spot with '0 yellow mold', #wizkills the mold north of her, steps there (spot B) and wishes for a second squeaky board. ^T to an occupied square says 'Sorry...'; safe_teleds()'s 40 random tries and its ring scan reject both trapped spots and every occupied one, so it uses the remembered trap spot A (766-767) and the board squeaks.
